title: A milestone in expanding access to AI
summary: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.
body: ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方宣布其ChatGPT广告业务年化收入运行率已达到10亿美元，并正在全球范围内进一步扩展，旨在通过免费及经济实惠的选项支持更广泛的AI普惠访问，标志着大模型商业化变现进入新阶段。原始信息显示：ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“A milestone in expanding access to AI”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布ChatGPT广告业务实现10亿美元年化收入运行率并加速全球扩张，对AI商业模式具有重大影响。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
